text: The downstream app runs swarm-persona from its own copy of deploy/aws/buildspec.yml with SP_REF pinned to a full commit SHA, and keeps its own config. A release here changes nothing there until someone syncs it (release.md, Downstream sync). Never edit the downstream app's repository from a session in this one.

tests/test_guard_live.py drives a real mitmdump and skips without one; deploy/aws/test.sh installs mitmproxy 11.1.3 and sets SWARM_PERSONA_MITMDUMP so they run there. Locally, a skipped live test is not a pass.
